notes: _parse_flow_from_zip_file joins temp_dir with the raw multipart file.filename (os.path.join, only a .zip suffix check): ../../x.zip writes outside the temp dir. Reachable unauthenticated at POST /api/v1|v2/serve/awel/flow/import (api_keys defaults to allow-all, /api/v1 short-circuits auth). Matches CVE-2025-6772 / issue 2774; the site remains unpatched upstream at the pinned sha. The extractall calls it eventually reaches are zipfile-sanitized; the flagged classes are filename-shaping (P2) and member-write (P4) sites.
